title: Arrange planar and interleaved vector lanes portably
goal: Interleave and recover independent channels, select vector halves and construct numeric lane patterns using portable vector operations.

selectionNotes: Portable vector APIs provide software fallback; no ISA-specific prerequisite is required for these operations.
Behavior evidence covers Vector128<int> and Vector128<float> on Windows x64, including a forced-disabled hardware-intrinsic process.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Use the .NET 11 vector and instruction contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against the .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 is the recorded test baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no experimental language feature is required.

prerequisites: SDK console project targeting net11.0 with ImplicitUsings=enable, Nullable=enable and namespace Playbook.Samples; include all supplied canonical declarations and imports.
constraints: Portable vector APIs provide software fallback; no ISA-specific prerequisite is required for these operations.
Behavior evidence covers Vector128<int> and Vector128<float> on Windows x64, including a forced-disabled hardware-intrinsic process.
No extra NuGet package/assets, provider, workload or rendering mode. No older-target package route or general performance guarantee is established.
stabilityLimitations: Verified using .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. These selected contracts have no publisher experimental annotation or required opt-in.

evidence.scope: Both actual target builds execute exact zip/unzip order, all concat halves, reverse and patterned lanes. Supplementary forced-disabled execution verifies the software route. No Arm/AVX-512 native or GA verification.
